description: Scroll. action=to: once to element/coordinates; action=until: repeatedly until element visible, network idle, or no new content (infinite scroll).

action.description: to jumps to a position or element; until scrolls repeatedly to load more

behavior.description: instant avoids waiting for smooth-scroll animations

container.description: until: selector that scrolls; default the document, or the largest scrollable element if the document does not scroll

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

max_scrolls.description: Cap on scroll steps, so an infinite feed terminates

step_px.description: px per step, default viewport height

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

until.description: no_new_content stops when the page height stops growing

x.description: Absolute horizontal position in px (action=to, without selector)

y.description: Absolute vertical position in px (action=to, without selector)

name: scroll
